documentType: HR investigation report (Awatere District Council, Ferguson v Kellogg bullying complaint)
authorshipNote: Authored by Eugene (per plan Decision (d), B1 is the incident anchor and owns Eugene's judgement). Drafted with Cowork assistance 2026-04-20.
notes: Each entry below uses mustMatch='substring' where variants are expected (e.g. surname appears as 'Ms Ferguson', 'Ferguson', 'Melissa Ferguson'), and 'exact' where the detection should match the precise string.

Some type assignments are deliberately conservative — e.g. medical diagnosis prose is typed 'personal-name' under s7(2)(a) rather than 'health-safety' (which is about public protective measures, not individual diagnoses). The v3.2 plan amendment discussed adding a new worked example for this pattern.

Witness names in the Interviews table and Findings section are typed 'harassment-risk' (s7(2)(f)(ii)) because the document is a bullying grievance — witness identities must be protected per Phase 3 Example 11 pattern. The investigator (Sarah Mitchell) is also typed 'harassment-risk' from Phase 3 PR B onwards: the reworded carve-out at `lib/pipeline/ai-detect.ts` flags investigator-in-grievance-context under s7(2)(f)(ii) rather than treating them as generic personal-name.
Organisation names (Awatere Medical Centre, Holroyd Partners) are typed 'confidential' with ground s7(2)(a) — type 'personal-name' is specifically for individuals.
Salary-band rows are typed 'confidential' with ground s7(2)(a) — individual compensation is privacy-sensitive PII but doesn't fit any other dedicated type.

Phase 4 entity-propagation retune (2026-04-23): Ferguson / Ms Ferguson / Kellogg / Mr Kellogg each expanded into per-page entries matching the canonical pages where the variant genuinely occurs in prose. The pipeline now emits one detection per (variant, page) — one from the AI anchor on page 1 (full name), the rest from entity propagation. Per-page expected entries align the ground truth with that reality; the previous no-page substring entries undercounted when propagation correctly flagged every page. See docs/detection-coverage-plan-2026-04.md Phase 4.
